Glassworm Unicode Attack on quartz-markdown-editor

Target: quartz-markdown-editor
Repository: N/A
Date: 2025-10-17 to 2026-03-13 (147 days)
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Extension
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Malicious Injection
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential Theft
User Impact: 0
Domain: marketplace.visualstudio.com (package host)
Artifact Type: extension
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The Glassworm threat actor published a malicious version of the quartz.quartz-markdown-editor VS Code extension. The payload was hidden using invisible PUA Unicode characters and designed to steal authentication tokens and exfiltrate secrets.

Compromised Versions

  • 0.3.0
